units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 1:16">Targ. Ex. I, 16</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>היא הדא</he>, v. <cite ref="D00003"><he>דָּא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 7:1:16">Y. Shebi. VII, 37ᶜ</cite> top <he>בהוא אתר</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:3">Shebi. VII, 3</cite> <he>בההוא אתרא</he>) in the same place.—<he>כל דהו</he> whatsoever, v. <cite ref="E00178">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Arakhin 2a:10">Arakh. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>נפשות כל דהו</he> human beings of any nature, v. <cite ref="K00669"><he>כָּל</he></cite>.—Y. Kil. VI, 31ᵇ top <he>כהיא דאמר וכ׳</he> (in Babli <he>כי הא</he>) as (that which) R. … said.—Pl. <cite ref="E00648"><he>הֵן</he></cite> (perhaps only in Hebr. phrases); <cite ref="E00460"><he>הִינוּן</he></cite>, <he>הִינִין</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 1:10">Targ. Y. Ex. I, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 1:19">Ib. 19</cite> (O. <he>אינ׳</he>); a. fr.—With prefix <cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>: <cite ref="E00174"><he>הַהוּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00174"><he>הַהִיא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 21:20">Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 20</cite>; a. fr.—In Talmud frequ. used to introduce a case.
<cite ref="Pesachim 3b:10">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ארמאה ד־</he> it occurred that a gentile &c.
Keth. 78ᵇ ה׳ איתתא ד־ the case came up of a woman that &c.; a. v. fr.—ה׳ גברא, ה׳ איתתא frequ. euphemistically for myself, thyself (to avoid ominous speech or curse).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:6:7">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אביו דה׳ ג׳</he> thy father. Ib.ᶜ top <he>חמית ה׳ א׳</he> I saw; <he>בעלה דה׳ א׳</he> thy husband; a. v. fr.—With prefix <he>ד־</he>: <he>דהוא</he>, <he>דהיא</he>, contr. <cite ref="D00162"><he>דּוּ</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00442"><he>דִּי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00002"><he>דְּ־</he></cite> a. <cite ref="D00162"><he>דּוּ</he></cite>.—With prefixed prep. <he>בְּהוֹן</he>, <cite ref="B00280"><he>בּוֹן</he></cite>, <he>לְהוֹן</he>, <cite ref="L00291"><he>לוֹן</he></cite>.
